notes.title: New Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
With great satisfaction we inform the new update 1.1.0 with the changes below:
[i]- Fixed a bug that prevented some texts from being displayed correctly when changing languages.[/i]
[i]- Addition of Easy Difficulty, as desired by the community.
(to access the new option, select settings menu from the main game screen)[/i]

We hope you enjoy the game!

Djamp Games
